parsed.why: Low-risk tier division: explicit gender-identity nondiscrimination, open ID markers including X, no facility ban, sanctuary-city care shield; no statewide hate-crime cover. Parent passport/entry regime still applies, capping the score below the protective tier.

Tier-1 universal exposure: 2025 birth-sex facility law with private cause of action, no state nondiscrimination or hate-crime law, listed among worst states targeting trans adults. Adds hostile layer to parent's document/entry regime.

Birth-sex bathroom mandate expanded to universities, freeze-frame prison treatment policy, no hate-crime statute, unrepealed sodomy provision; ranked escalating but not harshest. Thin record, but structural signals place it just below the parent line.

Most Protective tier: public-accommodations protection retained by popular vote, hate-crime statute with active reporting, self-declared ID including X markers, care shield law. Only parent passport/entry screening and unenforced sodomy text hold it back.

Adult-reaching birth-sex facility ban with public reporting form and documentary defence visitors cannot meet, pride-flag ban, dormitory exclusion, self-described leader in anti-LGBTQ laws; partial employment/housing protection only, no public-accommodation cover.
